commentary.text: 90+5' Nothing more will happen in this game as the referee blows for full time.
90+1' Alexandre Medina has decided to substitute Sergio Ruiz and he is replaced by Antonio Puertas (Granada CF).
90+1' 4 min. of stoppage-time to be played.
90' Yuri Berchiche (Ath Bilbao) is yellow-carded for breaking the rules of the game.
88' Benat Prados Diaz comes off the pitch to be replaced by Peru Nolaskoain (Ath Bilbao).
87' The Ath Bilbao players keep the ball and are exchanging a combination of passes. They are waiting for gaps in the defence to open up.

84' Aitor Paredes (Ath Bilbao) reacts well and displays good awareness inside the box to get on the end of the corner kick. He fails to direct the ball into the net as it flies narrowly wide of the left post. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Granada CF.
84' The referee and his assistant both point at the corner flag. Ath Bilbao will have an opportunity to threaten the opposition's goal.
83' Rough tackle by Benat Prados Diaz (Ath Bilbao). The referee blows his whistle for a foul.
80' That's the end of the game for Inaki Williams, who is replaced by Alex Berenguer (Ath Bilbao).
80' Here is a change. Inigo Ruiz de Galarreta is going off and Ernesto Valverde Tejedor gives the last tactical orders to Ander Herrera (Ath Bilbao).
79' Alexandre Medina has decided to make a change. Jose Callejon (Granada CF) replaces Lucas Boye.
79' It will be a substitution. Njegos Petrovic (Granada CF) is ready to enter the pitch as Gonzalo Villar walks off.
78' Nico Williams (Ath Bilbao) receives a yellow card from the referee for a foul that he committed a little earlier.
77' Inaki Williams (Ath Bilbao) strikes the ball towards goal, but it fails to reach the target after being well blocked by one of the defenders.

76' Inaki Williams (Ath Bilbao) jumps for a cross and produces a fine header from near the penalty spot, but it goes narrowly wide of the right post. The ball goes out of play and Granada CF will have a goal kick.
75' Ath Bilbao seem to be finding their feet as they enjoy some possession. They are waiting for the right moment to create new attacking opportunities.
73' Ignasi Miquel (Granada CF) makes an overly-aggressive challenge and Miguel Angel Ortiz Arias blows his whistle for a foul.
71' The game is interrupted as Nico Williams (Ath Bilbao) is flagged offside.
71' We can have a look at the statistics now, particularly the total attempts – 6:15.
70' Myrto Uzuni (Granada CF) gets a shot from inside the penalty area and it flies just wide of the left post. The ball goes out of play and Ath Bilbao will have a goal kick.
67' Ernesto Valverde Tejedor has decided to introduce fresh legs, with Asier Villalibre (Ath Bilbao) replacing Gorka Guruzeta.
67' Oscar de Marcos goes off the pitch and Yuri Berchiche (Ath Bilbao) comes on.
66' The Granada CF players are exchanging some short passes to try and open up the opposition’s defence and hit them swiftly on the break.

64' Gorka Guruzeta (Ath Bilbao) receives a fine cross inside the box and attempts to score a goal, but his strike flies just a few inches over the bar. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Granada CF.
64' Ath Bilbao earn a corner.
58' The ball spins to Inigo Lekue (Ath Bilbao) on the edge of the box. He hits across the ball and sends it goalwards, but it goes just wide of the left post.
58' The ball goes out for a corner. Ath Bilbao can continue in their attacking effort.
55' 1 - 1 Inigo Ruiz de Galarreta (Ath Bilbao) scores an own goal! No one would like to be in his position right now.
53' Oscar de Marcos (Ath Bilbao) makes a reckless foul in order to win the ball from his opponent. Miguel Angel Ortiz Arias has a clear sight of it and blows his whistle.
51' Granada CF enjoy a period of possession as they are exchanging some passes and waiting for an opportunity to strike.
48' Benat Prados Diaz (Ath Bilbao) gives away a foul for a fierce tackle on an opponent.
47' Inaki Williams (Ath Bilbao) commits a rough challenge and Miguel Angel Ortiz Arias blows his whistle for a foul.
46' The second half gets underway.
45+2' Miguel Angel Ortiz Arias has ended the first half by blowing the whistle.
45' We will have 2 min. of added time.
43' Inaki Williams (Ath Bilbao) climbs higher than the defenders inside the box and plants a towering header against the crossbar. What a great chance!
42' The corner is swung in but Ath Bilbao can’t take advantage as a defender sweeps the ball away.
40' A quickly taken corner by Granada CF.
37' Granada CF are bossing possession at the moment by exchanging some precise passes from player to player.
35' Benat Prados Diaz (Ath Bilbao) steadies himself and bends in a shot from the edge of the box towards the bottom right corner, but Andre Ferreira has it covered and makes a comfortable save.
34' Bryan Zaragoza (Granada CF) fails to beat the offside trap and the linesman puts his flag up.
33' Oihan Sancet (Ath Bilbao) places a shot at goal from the edge of the box that bends just wide of the right post. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Granada CF.
33' Great teamplay by Granada CF as they control the ball with a lot of short passes. Patience is the key if they want to find a gap in the defence to score.
32' The game is interrupted. Benat Prados Diaz (Ath Bilbao) has violated the rules in the battle for the ball. No protests or gestures are being made as he is quite aware of what he did.
31' The resulting set piece from Ath Bilbao is comfortably intercepted by one of the defending players.
30' The current number of shots on goal is 1:1.
28' Ignasi Miquel (Granada CF) gives away a foul for a clumsy challenge. Referee Miguel Angel Ortiz Arias saw the whole situation.
26' Ricard Sanchez (Granada CF) was too fierce in his attempt to get the ball from his opponent and Miguel Angel Ortiz Arias blows for a foul.

23' The ball falls kindly for Nico Williams (Ath Bilbao) inside the box and he goes for goal. It's a decent effort but flies just wide of the right post. The ball goes out of play and Granada CF will have a goal kick.
23' Raul Torrente (Granada CF) makes a rough challenge and Miguel Angel Ortiz Arias blows his whistle for a foul.
20' The match can continue after the interruption.
20' The match is abandoned!
18' The game is interrupted.
17' Nico Williams (Ath Bilbao) floats the ball in from the corner but it's intercepted.
14' Oscar de Marcos (Ath Bilbao) should know this behaviour is beyond the rules. He was too careless with his challenge and left Miguel Angel Ortiz Arias no option but to blow his whistle.
14' A precise cross towards the edge of the box was latched onto by Nico Williams (Ath Bilbao). He outjumped the defence and produced a powerful header which went a whisker wide of the right post.
11' Ath Bilbao can’t profit from the corner as the defence clear the ball upfield.
9' Aitor Paredes (Ath Bilbao) blasts the ball high over the crossbar.
8' The corner kick from Nico Williams (Ath Bilbao) is headed out of the penalty area by one of the defenders.
6' Inaki Williams (Ath Bilbao) scores from quite a difficult position as he leaps high to connect with a cross and powers his header low into the middle of the goal. Excellent finish.
1' Myrto Uzuni (Granada CF) produces a good strike that sails to the bottom right corner, but the goalkeeper shows great reflexes and dives to keep the effort from hitting the net.
1' The first half has just begun.
The players are out at last! Granada CF will take the kick-off.
Miguel Angel Ortiz Arias will officiate today.
